The request URL parsing is unchanged. Streaming mode still uses `get_url_attributes` and `HTTP_REQUEST_METHOD`, while non-streaming mode still records `aws.request.url`, `HTTP_QUERY`, `HTTP_FRAGMENT`, and `HTTP_METHOD` with the same values and conditions. The change moves these attributes onto the client-call span and allows retries to overwrite them, both explicitly excluded by the criterion.
